study.question: The same-seed scaled_pair versus normalized_pair comparison had click AUC 0.6561588765 versus 0.6392315334, while auxiliary mean AUC was 0.8619730307 versus 0.8710676255. Split (0.6538657134) and fused_pair (0.6539058792) did not beat scaled_pair (0.6561588765). The original split hypothesis of beneficial simultaneous content/volume banks is unsupported by this round. Earlier mass_sum and count_scaled tied closely on click (0.6549425289/0.6549248114), both above mass_normalized (0.6449288198); learned interest-mass specificity is therefore unresolved. Earlier field/event and grouped/global contrasts were all below DIN (0.6555440824), and feedback grouping hurt click. No recorded training failure is present in the supplied thirteen successful receipts; weak branches remain negative outcomes. These are one fixed-seed validation observations, not repeated support or proof of task interference. Can task-specific direct history-summary scales recover auxiliary ranking while retaining the click-oriented shared representation, or does the observed tradeoff require changing shared transport or optimization?
study.hypothesis: For normalized retrieval content u and visible exposure count n, preserve the incumbent two projected n*u/2 banks in shared attention. Give click and auxiliary direct tower readouts separately assigned views, either u or n*u/2, using the same two projections and unchanged per-group counts. The preferred task_scale arm sends n*u/2 to click and u to cart/fav/buy. Task-aligned readout scale, rather than merely making both scales globally available, may reduce the observed quality tradeoff. This is an architectural/optimization hypothesis; negative transfer and novelty are unverified.

nearest_work.difference: Exact empirical parent; retains its entire shared representation and adds no trainable tensors. Only the direct summary input supplied to task towers can change. The scaled_reference arm should reproduce parent predictions/cost apart from the extra unused normalized-view computation.

The earlier split sent normalized/scaled banks jointly into attention and every direct task readout. This proposal fixes shared transport to scaled/scaled and assigns scale by task at the direct readout. It does not claim that the unsuccessful split refutes dual-scale mechanisms.

Archived primary text lines272-277 already motivates preserving activation intensity rather than unit-sum attention. Here the kernel remains normalized sigmoid and the explicit exposure scale n/2 is task assigned only on the direct readout; learned activation mass is not proposed as new.

Pinned benchmark forward/tokenizer lines113-159 verifies target pooling, field/task tokens and shared interaction. This proposal inherits a nearby stacked pattern but uses local fieldwise retrieval, explicit counts, direct skips and parameter-free task scale assignment. It is not a HiFormer reproduction or originality claim.

Pinned benchmark lines123-219 initialize task history hubs from task masks and repeatedly aggregate/broadcast. Here task specificity is only the direct summary scale, with global masked retrieval and unchanged shared attention; no task hub parameters or repeated broadcast are introduced.

Section2.3 supplies external architectural context, not evidence of effectiveness under this fixed single-pass local protocol. Original INFNet full text is unavailable through the authorized registry; stronger priority or reproduction claims remain unverified.

study.proposed_difference: Add click_readout_scale and auxiliary_readout_scale architecture enums. Compute both (P0(nu/2),P1(nu/2)) and (P0(u),P1(u)) with identical existing presence gates and count projections; scale before the affine projections so biases/counts are not divided. Always run shared attention on the scaled pair. Select one common direct-history input per task tower, preserving raw static fields, counts and shared task tokens. Cross the two scale assignments in a 2x2 factorial. No added parameters, input information, loss hook or host recipe change. The scaled/scaled control is an exact arithmetic parent reproduction subject to host numerical verification.
predictions: Primary directional prediction: averaged over auxiliary-scale assignments, scaled click readout has higher click validation AUC than normalized click readout. Selection remains full-population click AUC only, even if another arm has better auxiliary mean.

Averaged over click-scale assignments, normalized auxiliary readouts increase cart/fav/buy mean AUC; report each task AUC and unweighted Logloss separately. A mean gain of at least 0.003 is a predeclared practical target, not a statistical-significance threshold.

The task_scale arm is predicted to retain or improve scaled_reference click AUC while improving auxiliary mean, and to beat reversed_scale in click and auxiliary mean. If auxiliary improvement trades away click, report the tradeoff and do not promote it on auxiliary score.

At fixed weights and evaluation mode, task_scale click outputs must equal scaled_reference click outputs, and normalized_readout click outputs must equal reversed_scale click outputs; any trained click difference within those pairs must enter through training coupling, not direct access to a different click view. Similarly auxiliary fixed-weight outputs pair by auxiliary setting.

All arms have the same 32,196,612 expected total and 403,396 expected dense parameters for this FeatureMap, matching parent; measure rather than assume wall/GPU time, memory and model-only throughput/p50/p95 latency. Additional projection compute is charged in all arms.

Inspect the inherited fixed history bins (empty,1-16,17-64,>64) for click AUC/Logloss and counts. With no visible history both views are exactly zero before learned identities, so fixed-weight outputs must be identical across all arms on empty histories; after separate training no such equality is predicted.
falsifiers: If scaled_reference does not reproduce parent within host numerical tolerance under the identical seed/recipe, stop interpreting candidate differences until implementation or nondeterminism is resolved; retain the failed receipt and cost.

If task_scale fails to improve auxiliary mean over scaled_reference or incurs lower click AUC, the predicted simultaneous benefit is unsupported. Do not relabel an auxiliary-only improvement as primary success.

If normalized_readout performs as well as or better than task_scale across tasks, task-specific assignment has no demonstrated benefit over generic direct-path normalization. If reversed_scale ties or wins, task alignment is unsupported.

If click/auxiliary factorial effects do not have the predicted task-specific directions, reject the proposed scale preference at the direct readout under this frozen recipe. A null result does not rule out task-specific shared transport.

Any dependence on masked IDs/actions, target action, current labels, history padding, missing outputs, nonfinite gradients/loss, changed parameter shapes or unintended training recipe invalidates the implementation comparison.
alternative_explanations: Shared embeddings/retrieval/projections still receive all task gradients; the direct path is task specific but training is coupled.
Fixed learning rates, Dice statistics and BF16 can make amplitude an optimization effect; validation alone cannot separate semantic intensity from conditioning.
Three auxiliary tasks are changed together; any aggregate benefit needs per-task inspection and a later per-task ablation.
One seed and reused validation allow selection noise/overfitting; no significance or causal gradient-conflict claim.
Historical presence gates and counts remain directly available in both views, so a gain cannot be attributed to newly exposing count information.

The earlier normalized-versus-scaled effect could arise in shared attention rather than the direct skip; this study deliberately holds transport scaled. A null result motivates a later matched transport/readout factorial, not an unplanned change now.

Primary and auxiliary labels differ in semantics/prevalence: auxiliary labels match user/category/brand over24h rather than direct advertisement conversions. No production causal or attribution claim is justified.
The parent advantage over DIN is only 0.0006147941 click AUC in one seed; capacity differs from DIN and no measured equal-compute superiority has been established.
